critical_code_review_comments: engine.py grouping constants (TW_GROUP_S=4, GROUP_MAX_S=15, GROUP_RECENT_S=8, SAME_SPOT_S=1, SAME_MEMBER_IOU, SAME_MEMBER_DIST) are hard-coded module-level — consider moving to config.json to allow site-level tuning without a redeploy.

tracker.py merge_twins is intentionally OFF for the vehicle tracker (so queued cars still count) — this asymmetry is correct but worth a one-line code comment at the construction site in engine.py for future maintainers.

_same_member() velocity-projection path assumes stable per-track velocity; may misfire on jittery YOLO flicker — current random-seed tests pass but a worst-case fuzz with large frame skips could be added later.

rca of the issue: User saw 4 identical WhatsApp 'Exit — BICYCLE' photos within 3s when 2 people pushed 2 bicycles side by side. RCA: in the centroid tracker, two slow adjacent objects with YOLO flicker produce twin tracks / ID swaps; each extra track crossing the line emitted its own WhatsApp alert. FIX (verified green): (1) two-wheeler crossings now flow through _queue_group() like persons — one alert per (category,direction) after TW_GROUP_S=4s quiet (max GROUP_MAX_S=15s), with N count and all boxes rendered; caption switches to '🏍️ Two-wheeler Exit — 2 bikes' when N>1. (2) _same_member() merges a new crossing into an active or recent (GROUP_RECENT_S=8s) group by same track id, same spot within SAME_SPOT_S=1s (IoU>0.2), born-on-member-track within 1s, or velocity-projected member location (IoU>0.2 or centre within 0.5 box-size). (3) tracker2 is built with merge_twins=True so an uncounted twin glued (IoU>=0.55) to a counted track for 4 updates inherits counted state (vehicle tracker keeps merge_twins=False so a queued car still counts). Reproduction via tests/repro_two_bikes.py: before=2-3 alerts, after=1 alert count=2 across all seeds.
